# GLFW platform inventory

Audited surface: `glfw 0.62.0`, `glfw-sys 8.0.0`, GLFW C `3.4.0`, fork `eee570b6f0881d49a678ebe8ec32b50c3dcea4de`.

A status is scoped to the named backend and stated conditions. `unverified` is not a compatibility guarantee.

| C symbol | Rust wrappers | VMNL usage | Backend status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `glfwCreateWindow` | `Glfw::create_window` | `WindowBuilder::build` | all: conditional (Creates a native window or returns null with an error callback.) | test:native_window::null_backend_creates_a_no_api_window_without_abort |
| `glfwCreateWindowSurface` | `Glfw::create_window_surface` | Not used | all: conditional (Creates a platform Vulkan surface; macOS uses Metal portability extensions where available.) | justification:VMNL surface creation is exercised separately through raw-window-handle |
| `glfwFocusWindow` | `PWindow::focus` | `Window::focus` | wayland: best-effort (Compositor will likely ignore unsolicited focus requests.); x11: best-effort (Requests focus; policy may deny it.); win32-cocoa: best-effort (Requests focus.) | test:platform_probe:x11:focus, justification:focus grant is intentionally not asserted |
| `glfwGetClipboardString` | `PWindow::get_clipboard_string` | Not used | win32: conditional (Reads Unicode text; another process may temporarily hold the lock.); x11-wayland-cocoa: conditional (Reads native clipboard text.) | justification:official backend remarks reviewed |
| `glfwGetCocoaWindow` | `PWindow::window_handle` | `internal Vulkan surface creation` | cocoa: conditional (Returns the NSWindow used to derive an AppKit view handle.) | test:GPU surface tests on a qualified Cocoa environment, justification:native Cocoa runtime remains experimental |
| `glfwGetFramebufferSize` | `PWindow::get_framebuffer_size` | `Window::get_framebuffer_size` | all: supported (Returns framebuffer dimensions in pixels.) | justification:GPU tests validate swapchain-facing use |
| `glfwGetGammaRamp` | `Monitor::get_gamma_ramp` | Not used | wayland: unsupported (Gamma control requires a privileged protocol and is unavailable.); x11-win32-cocoa: conditional (Returns the current ramp; Win32 requires 256 entries for setting.) | justification:official backend remarks reviewed |
| `glfwGetKey` | `PWindow::get_key` | `KeyboardState` | all: supported (Returns cached key state.) | justification:public API tests validate state transitions without a native window |
| `glfwGetMonitorContentScale` | `Monitor::get_content_scale` | `MonitorInfo::content_scale` | wayland: conditional (Fractional scaling may not be represented exactly by GLFW 3.4.); x11-win32-cocoa: supported (Returns content scale reported by the backend.) | justification:official monitor reference reviewed |
